skills.name: study-design-identifier
skills.description: Identifies a paper's real study design from its methods, separates primary and secondary layers in hybrid papers, and corrects misleading author design labels.

skills.name: medical-research-literature-reader-pro
skills.description: Classifies a medical paper into clinical, computational, experimental or hybrid tracks and writes a structured critical appraisal with explicit claim boundaries.

skills.name: rct-bias-assessment-rob2
skills.description: Applies the five RoB 2 domains to a randomized trial result and returns domain-level and overall risk-of-bias judgments in a fixed JSON schema.

skills.name: diagnostic-study-quality-assessment-quadas-2
skills.description: Answers QUADAS-2 signalling questions for a diagnostic accuracy study across patient selection, index test, reference standard and flow/timing, with quotes.

skills.name: result-reliability-checker
skills.description: Audits whether each main result is trustworthy by tracing design, bias control, statistics, validation chain and claim discipline to a per-claim reliability judgment.

skills.name: paper-to-claim-verifier
skills.description: Checks whether a claim is supported by the paper it cites, diagnosing citation drift, context transfer and causality inflation, and proposes citation-safe wording.

skills.name: high-value-paper-screener
skills.description: Reading-priority triage: judges a paper's question fit and screening value and returns full read, skim, skip or uncertain, keeping relevance apart from quality.

skills.name: figure-first-paper-reader
skills.description: Reads a paper figure by figure, maps each figure to the claim it is meant to carry, and judges whether the visual evidence supports that claim.

skills.name: methods-reverse-engineer
skills.description: Reconstructs a paper's methods into an ordered, reproducible workflow, labelling explicit, inferred and missing steps, and builds a replication checklist.

skills.name: reproducibility-check
skills.description: Audits a supplied Methods section for replication-critical omissions and ambiguities, rates reproducibility risk, and gives open-science practice guidance.

skills.name: reporting-guideline-compliance-checker
skills.description: Checks a manuscript against its matching reporting guideline family (CONSORT, STROBE, PRISMA, TRIPOD) and ranks missing or weak reporting items by severity.

skills.name: scientific-critical-thinking
skills.description: General rigor checklist for methodology, bias, confounding, statistical pitfalls, logical fallacies and claim proportionality when no design-specific tool fits.

skills.name: contradictory-findings-resolver
skills.description: Explains why studies on one topic disagree by comparing population, endpoint, sample source, platform, model, validation depth and interpretation.

skills.name: retraction-watcher
skills.description: Parses a reference list and queries Crossref, PubMed and Open Retractions by DOI or PMID for retractions and expressions of concern; needs network access.
